description: Evaluate RAG retrieval: rank passages against a query, compute Precision@k / Recall@k and a PASS/FAIL verdict from your relevance labels. Modes: (1) give every passage the `score` YOUR reranker produced — deterministic, offline, the mode to gate CI on; (2) no scores, no key — a local BM25 keyword baseline, never a judgement of a neural reranker; (3) api_key for an NVIDIA account that still has reranking (NVIDIA retired the hosted endpoints on 2026-05-18).

passages.text: Paris is the capital of France.

api_key.description: NVIDIA key, used only when no passage has a score; never stored.

score.description: Your reranker's score (higher = more relevant). On all passages or none.

name: rerank_evaluate
